FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of CURRENCY NOTE PRESS, A UNIT OF SPMCIL A/C (Name of the Seller). For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Payment online through RTGS / internet banking also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). On-line payment shall be in

Successful Bidder to indicate Contract number and name of Seller entity in the transaction details field at the time of on-line transfer. Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the Online Payment Transfer in place of PBG within 15 days of award of contract. 4. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses I) TECHNICAL SPECIFICATION Item Name. BFM/100 band/30 mm Poly i. Material - BOPP ii. Roll Width - 30 mm ± 0.2 mm iii. Thickness - 60 ± 5 Microns iv. Colour - White v. Weight of each roll - Approx. 1.8 - 2.1 kg. vi. Sealing Temp. - 150 deg to 190 deg C vii. Outside Roll diameter - 340 mm ± 5 mm viii. Cardboard core (ID) - 76 mm ± 1 mm ix. Cardboard core (OD) - 96 mm ± 1 mm x. Winding - Must be on Hard Cardboard core, Compact & Tight. • Each roll should contain approx. equal quantity of length / weight and should be free from joints and coating lumps. • Packing: Set of three rolls of equal length should be packed in one Polythene bag/ waterproof m

aterial & appropriate box may be provided for packing of rolls to avoid any physical damage to roll and core in transit or at the time of delivery. • The width of core must be same as the poly band. • Certificate of Analysis (COA) should be provided with each lot of supply. • Misc.: Even after giving the initial suitability of bulk supply of material, if the band roll found defe ctive/damaged during actual production on machines will have to be replaced by the supplier at su pplier's own cost & risk as and when initiated to the supplier till the supplied stock consumed. II) PRE-QUALIFICATION/ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA The following shall be the minimum eligibility criteria for selection of bidders for White Poly Band R olls. 01. Capacity and Capability: The bidder should have an annual capacity to manufacture and supply at least 7000 Kg. of BOPP Roll. Note: Participating bidder needs to submit all related documents along with the bid. Further, CNP r eserves the right (if necessary) to verify the capacity & capability of the firm to establish that the fi rm is capable to successfully manufacture & supply of tendered items. 02. Item-wise Minimum Capacity Required From Seller: Tenderers have to quote for minimum 25% of the total tender quantity i.e. 4375 Kg. of White Poly Band Rolls failing which offer will not be considered and bid will be summarily rejected. III) Other requirements for the Bidders: 1. The bidder has to submit Power of Attorney/ Authorization indicating that authorized signatory i s competent and legally authorized to submit the tender and /or enter into legally binding contrac t. 2. PAN and Goods & Service Tax Registration (GST): Relevant Proof in support shall be submi tted. IV) UNDERTAKING(S) AND DECLARATION:

a) The bidder should give undertaking/declaration that they have read and understood all the ter ms & conditions of tender documents including GIT and GCC and submitting unconditional accepta nce to all terms & conditions. b) The bidder should give a duly signed and stamped undertaking of declaration that they are not been blacklisted/debarred for dealing by any Government department in India. c) Documentary/Undertaking against Make in India status i.e. being a Class I/Class II supplier with details of percentage of local contents. d) Undertaking towards compliance of, border sharing criteria as per guidelines issued by Govern ment of India (vide letter no.F.No.6/18/2019-PPD dated 23rd/24th July 2020 or any further amend ments thereof). Please Click the link for further details of GIT and GCC as per the links: GIT : https://www.spmcil.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/GIT-3.0-1.pdf GCC : https://www.spmcil.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/GCC-3.0-1.pdf V) Parallel Contracts (Splitting): CNP-Nashik reserves its right to conclude Parallel contracts, with more than one bidder (for the same tender). The Parallel Contracts would be concluded as giv en below subject to alternate bidder matching the Prices with lowest bidder: i) In case of splitting it shall be done in the ratio of 70:30 respectively or spare supply capacity. ii) L-1 shall be awarded at least 70% mentioned above or his spare supply capacity whichever is lowe r and iii) For the rest of the contract quantity, the lowest rate accepted will be counter offered to t he L-2 party. On acceptance of the counteroffer, the order will be placed on L-2 for 30% or the spa re supply capacity of the L-2 bidder which is lower and so on to other tenderers. In case of non-acc eptance of the counteroffer by L-2 party, similar offer shall be made to L-3 and L-4 and so on. iv) F or MSE firms, Parallel contract is applicable as per MSME guidelines issued from time to time. v) In case of only one eligible bidder, then quantity will be allocated on the basis of quoted quantity or 100% of the tendered quantity, whichever is less. vi) In case of two eligible bidders, quantity will b e allocated in the ratio of 70:30 or the offered quantity respectively. VI) Warranty period: The warranty is applicable for 03 months from the date of supply. VII) Option Clause: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase/decrease the ordered quantity b y up to 25% at any time, till final delivery date of the contract (or the extended delivery date of th e contract), by giving reasonable notice even though the quantity ordered initially has been suppli ed in full before the last date of Delivery period (or the extended delivery period of the contract). VIII) Payment Terms: 100% payments shall be made for each lot to the seller after successfully supply and acceptance o

f material on pro-rata basis. IX) Performance Security Deposit: 5% of order value. Note : Before issue of order on GeM on successful firm "Notification of Award of Contract" will be is sued on firm duly requesting to deposit the performance security within 15 days (as per GeM) X) Contact Details: Email: purchase.cnpnashik@spmcil.com XI) Bidder must submit check list of below mentioned documents as per Buyer added bi d Specific ATC:- Sl. No. Description Documentary evidence towards Pre-Qualification/Eligibility Criteria as per Clause II o 1. f Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC. 2. Undertaking's towards clause IV of Buyer added bid specific ATC 3. Documentary evidence towards GST Registration Certificate & PAN Card of Bidder 4. Duly signed and Sealed Technical Specification as an acceptance. 5. Power of Attorney/ Authorization 6. Any other document as per tender, if required. Note : 1. Anti- Bribery Management System (ABMS): By participating in this tender, the suppliers/ Vendor s/Contractors are deemed to have undertaken that they shall not give or take, any financial or non -financial bribe, to or from anyone during the tender or during the execution of the contract therea fter and if they notice any such incident happening, they shall report it to Vigilance. 2. Bidders to submit ZED and LEAN certifications by Quality Council of India if available. If not available, bidders are encouraged to apply for ZED & LEAN certifications by Quality Council o f India. 3. Bidders to submit TReDS platform on boarding details including platform name, platform ID etc, if available. If not available, bidders are encouraged to register on TReDS platform. .
